mbs.text: Melira, a sylvok outcast immune to phyresis, is freed from Tezzeret's surgery room when Elspeth rages and slays every Phyrexian there, and Koth and Venser free her too.
She heals everyone in Ezuri's camp infected by the oil, then leaves with the companions.
Karn asks the group to lead the resistance with Melira, and Venser gives his life and spark to Karn, curing him and releasing him from Phyrexian tyranny.
